name: least-used entry is evicted
input: read one of two entries, then insert a third
test:
cache = LFUCache(2)
cache.put('a', 10)
cache.put('b', 20)
assert cache.get('a') == 10
cache.put('c', 30)
assert cache.get('b') is None
assert cache.get('a') == 10
assert cache.get('c') == 30

name: least-recently-used key breaks a frequency tie
input: both keys reach frequency two, then insert a third
test:
cache = LFUCache(2)
cache.put('a', 1)
cache.put('b', 2)
assert cache.get('a') == 1
assert cache.get('b') == 2
cache.put('c', 3)
assert cache.get('a') is None
assert cache.get('b') == 2
assert cache.get('c') == 3

name: updating an existing key changes its value and frequency
input: update the older of two keys before a new insertion
test:
cache = LFUCache(2)
cache.put('a', 1)
cache.put('b', 2)
cache.put('a', 11)
cache.put('c', 3)
assert cache.get('a') == 11
assert cache.get('b') is None
assert cache.get('c') == 3

name: misses do not affect use and one-slot cache replaces its entry
input: read a missing key, then insert into capacity one
test:
cache = LFUCache(1)
assert cache.get('missing') is None
cache.put('a', 7)
assert cache.get('a') == 7
assert cache.get('missing') is None
cache.put('b', 8)
assert cache.get('a') is None
assert cache.get('b') == 8

name: frequency stays decisive across several insertions
input: a frequently read entry survives successive evictions
test:
cache = LFUCache(2)
cache.put('anchor', 1)
cache.put('old', 2)
assert cache.get('anchor') == 1
assert cache.get('anchor') == 1
cache.put('new', 3)
assert cache.get('old') is None
cache.put('later', 4)
assert cache.get('new') is None
assert cache.get('anchor') == 1
assert cache.get('later') == 4
